annotations.title: Linear regression (OLS, up to 10 predictors) with diagnostics

description: Linear regression (OLS, up to 10 predictors) with diagnostics — Ordinary least squares. y= comma-separated outcome values (required, up to 5000); x= one predictor as a comma list or several predictors separated by ; (each same length as y, max 10). Optional names= (comma names for predictors), predict= (one value per predictor) for a point prediction with 95% confidence and prediction intervals, intercept=false. Returns equation, coefficients with SE/t/p/95% CI, R-squared, adjusted R-squared, F test, residual SE, AIC, Durbin-Watson, VIF multicollinearity, outliers by studentized residual, and notes. Offline. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
